summary: Frontend-only regression test after code-quality fixes (AuthContext useMemo/useCallback, Login console.error, ProgressRing RING_TRANSITION). All 5 regression scenarios verified against live preview URL. Auth (admin + member), session persistence across all member pages, wrong-password error, logout via sidebar, member->admin approval flow, and points reflection on member dashboard all work correctly. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor a11y warning in browser console: Radix DialogContent for 'Bijscholing registreren' is missing a `Description`/`aria-describedby` — add a <DialogDescription> to silence the warning and improve screen-reader UX.

Admin review dialog defaults `assign-points` to the currently stored value even for already Goedgekeurd trainings; clicking Beoordelen->Goedkeuren on an approved training with the default value silently overwrites previously assigned points (observed: TEST Onderwerp 4pt -> 3pt). Consider disabling the approve button when status is already Goedgekeurd, or requiring an explicit confirm.
